note: When the parser encounters '&' in a compound selector, it marks the selector as having a real parent reference. This flag propagates through the AST and later triggers the vulnerable code path in resolve_parent_refs.
An empty compound selector causes parseComplexSelector to return an empty SelectorList, which can lead to an empty selector stack entry.
For directives like @media, an empty SelectorList is pushed onto the selector stack. This empty entry becomes the 'parent' when resolve_parent_refs is called.
When old_at_root_without_rule is true (inside @at-root (without: rule)), implicit_parent is false, which changes the behavior of resolve_parent_refs and can lead to an empty vars vector.
The selector stack (pstack) is passed to resolve_parent_refs. If the stack contains only empty SelectorList entries, the parent will be an empty list.
Accesses the back of the selector stack. If pstack is empty (size 0), this is undefined behavior and MSAN detects a use-of-uninitialized-value.
If vars is empty (because chroots() is true and no elements were pushed), permutateAlt computes in.size()-1 which underflows to SIZE_MAX, causing an out-of-bounds read on the state array.
